summary: Anchor Date charts now show 3 key stats per chart — prior 14-day avg, target date value, and 5-day post avg.
whatsNew: Anchor Date Investigation: every chart now shows a 3-stat summary bar — Prior to target date 14-day avg, On target date value, and After target date 5-day avg. All key insight visible at a glance without tapping.
fixes: Cross-chart tooltip interference permanently resolved by removing the tooltip system and replacing it with always-visible stat pills. Charts are now fully passive.
